items.sourceName: Wikimedia Commons, originally published by Pierre Markuse
items.title: Sentinel satellite analysis of Cyclone Gabrielle flooding near Napier, 2023
items.dateDisplay: 15 February 2023 (processed satellite image; depicts February 2023 flooding)
items.credit: Pierre Markuse; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [2023]. Source material distributed via Wikimedia Commons under CC BY 2.0; WebP versions resized without cropping.
items.altText: Satellite radar visualisation of flooding around Napier in Hawke's Bay during Cyclone Gabrielle in February 2023.
items.caption: Copernicus Sentinel data processed by Pierre Markuse, showing flooding near Napier during Cyclone Gabrielle in February 2023. The image illustrates observed flood extent and is not an NZTA operational GIS screenshot.
items.context: Image depicts the actual 2023 cyclone flooding relevant to the emergency period. It does not document the content, software or results of the NZTA operational platform discussed in the linked historical event.

items.sourceName: Wikimedia Commons / NASA Earth Observing System Data and Information System
items.title: Cyclone Gabrielle approaches New Zealand in NASA MODIS imagery, 2023
items.credit: NASA Aqua MODIS / EOSDIS Worldview; U.S. Government public-domain Earth observation imagery. WebP versions resized without cropping.
items.altText: Satellite image of Cyclone Gabrielle cloud bands as the cyclone approaches the North Island of New Zealand on 13 February 2023.
items.caption: NASA Aqua MODIS satellite observation of Cyclone Gabrielle approaching New Zealand, captured on 13 February 2023.
items.context: An authentic dated earth-observation image of the 2023 storm. It does not depict a GIS platform or a later emergency management map.
